## Feature specification: Upgrade to the Team plan

> An owner who has reached the monthly invoice limit moves the workspace to Team and carries on sending.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Id | `FEAT-upgrade-plan` |
| Belongs to | Ledgerly › Billing and plans › Subscription: trial, start, change, cancel, renew |
| Kind | user_facing |
| Tier | 2 |
| Maturity | outlined supported · outlined claimed |
| Approval | draft |

### 1. Purpose and value

Turns hitting the free limit into an upgrade instead of a dead end. The owner should be able to go from the blocked send to a working Team plan without losing the invoice they were sending. Out of scope: downgrades and cancellation, handled with the rest of the subscription lifecycle.

**Serves:** _nothing recorded_

**For:** Account owner
